summary: Skale’s first-property setup should support a centralized, role-based operating model. The calls support external agent-tour scheduling through Elise AI, Entrata tracking numbers, recurring parking and storage items, partial resident payments, repayment agreements, manual lease generation after deposit clearance, structured move-in/move-out and maintenance workflows, and documented work-order completion. Accounting requirements from the latest call—especially owner distributions, invoice intake, management fees, move-in billing, and deposit migration—remain workflow-design items rather than settled catalog settings.
